title: Phoenix's Living Textures
description: A Resource Pack that Aims to bring life and a new coat of paint to Minecraft, by @PhoenixPlaysMC on YouTube
body:
# **Phoenix's Living Textures**
### **Introduction**
My goal is to re-texture all of Minecraft, if you want to report a bug, or help decide the next block I texture, head over to my Youtube Channel, I'd love to see you there! https://www.youtube.com/@PhoenixPlaysMC

I am a small creator and college student, so please dont steal this, and every download, view, or subscribe helps a ton!

### **So far this resource pack re-textures:**
- Torches
- All Exposed Cut Copper Blocks (Re-named to Lightly Weathered Cut Copper)
- Dirt
- Grass
- Snowy Grass
- Path Blocks
- Coarse Dirt
- Oak Logs & Wood
- Stripped Oak Logs
- Dark Oak Logs & Wood
- Pale Oak Logs & Wood
- Acacia Logs & Wood
- Birch  Logs & Wood
- Cherry Logs & Wood
- Mangrove Logs & Wood
- Spruce logs & Wood
- Jungle Logs & Wood
- Warped Stem & Wood
- Crimson Stem & Wood
